newsitem.title: USA: KeyCorp says to offer Schwab mutual fund.
newsitem.headline: KeyCorp says to offer Schwab mutual fund.

text.p: KeyCorp said Thursday it will offer Charles Schwab & Co's OneSource mutual fund product starting in March 1997.

"Key prides itself on being a world-class provider of investment products and services through multiple delivery channels that are both high in quality and convenient for our customers," Jack Kopnisky, president of KeyCorp's retail brokerage subsidiary, Key Investments Inc, said in a statement.
KeyCorp said it will be available through Key's discount brokerage division nationwide via a toll free telephone number.

KeyCorp said the OneSource program has assets of $36 billion and that Charles Schwab & Co has more than four million active investor accounts with over $251 billion in client assets. It is a unit of Charles Schwab Corp.
KeyCorp, with about $65 billion in assets, focuses on corporate banking, consumer finance and community banking and operates in 44 states.
